title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Outside the Fluffy☆Trampoline Dome

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there it is! The second trial!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... This time, there's a box for drawings or raffles, a video camera and a handwritten set of instructions. I'll start by reading it.

rows.Speaker: Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line:
“Trial 2: Improv!
Draw three topics from the box and face the camera when you're ready to perform!”

rows.Speaker: Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line: “Warning! You're not allowed to redraw your topics, so choose carefully! Anyway, good luck♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, an improvised show.
This is definitely my strong suit, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The way these instructions are written...
It feels so different from the original letter, and I've seen this handwriting before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, this can't be Saki.
There's no reason for her to write such a letter or cooperate with the sender.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
For now, I'll draw my topics!
Three, was it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... “Space”, “Band” and “Plushies”...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. The second trial's going to be a cakewalk for me. Does it not realize how many improv plays I've put on for Saki?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright... Action!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yesss!
Sounds like I passed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But where am I supposed to go next?
The instructions I read just now didn't make any mention of that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there's more on the back...

rows.Speaker: Reverse of the Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line: “If you hear the signal that you've passed, go to the location of the final trial. The Wonder Stage♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's essentially giving me a home-field advantage. Bring it on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa's play was so good☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was. Not only did he incorporate each topic rather nicely, but he even came up with a fun story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A space alien who sets its sights on Earth after invading countless other worlds but must take possession of a plushie to adapt to the environment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it discovers the beauty of music after learning that the owner of the plushie used to play in a band.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The finale was also pretty good considering he made it up on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To think that the space alien tells its friends all about music and decides to set out on a journey to spread what he learned far and wide instead of invading.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa certainly has a talent for telling these kinds of stories.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, did the camera get everything?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's all recorded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness! We really should show Saki and the others this since they couldn't make it today♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. We owe them that much for coming up with all these topics for us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, why don't we start making our way over to the location for the final trial?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's nothing here. Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that the sender of that letter would be waiting for me here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I've come this far!
Quit hiding and show yourself!
Let us get this final trial of yours underway!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Or are you too scared to face me?
Don't tell me you've run off already.
Who said anything about running?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's been quite a while since we last spoke like this, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-You're...!
Sakurako Seiryuin?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Indeed. None other than the prima donna of the number one show stage in Phoenix Wonderland... Sakurako Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: And it is I who sent you that letter of challenge!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Thank you for the dull reaction.
Anyway, it's time to start the final trial.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Which simply involves... Acting!
Why don't you show me some of the performances you did as an ambassador that were touted as being so wonderfully elegant?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I know all of “A Pianist Named Thorpe,” so choose whichever scene suits your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You say that... But I can't really do much without a piano...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Not to worry.
Bring it up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! A piano?! From the trapdoor?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I had it brought over from the Phoenix Stage, so you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Talk about being prepared!
Well played, Sakurako Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, just sit back and watch!
Behold, the new heights I've reached as an actor...!

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now... But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“And it's the day of the contest.
Thanks to them, I was hardly able to practice at all...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“The seats are... Oh, it's a full house.
I'm getting dizzy just thinking about having to play in front of all of them.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “No, I just want to...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I just want to keep playing.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How's that, Sakurako Seiryuin?!
Enjoy my rendition of Thorpe?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Sakurako Seiryuin, you there?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Ugh! Will you be quiet?!
I was trying to immerse myself in the music!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why am I the one who's apologizing?! Also, did I pass this trial?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
You really have to ask...?
You passed! Happy?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But I see that you're capable of more than just obnoxiously loud acting now...
I agree. Our troupe leader has come quite a long way, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! What are you all doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for pulling one over on you like this, Tsukasa. We were actually all behind that letter you received.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a little early, but we wanted to celebrate your birthday by having a big surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! This is a birthday surprise?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get your confusion...
Having the birthday boy undergo a bunch of trials still sorta doesn't make much sense to me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? It's because things are much more fun and thrilling this way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... I'd expect no less from you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You would've likely seen right through a more rudimentary plan. Also, you seemed to have fun during our little trials.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I most certainly did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. As a reward for overcoming all of these trials, we'd like you to join us for a special party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A special party?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Sakurako
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...! You're all here too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. We really wanted to be a part of this surprise!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasa, we wish you a very happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel so blessed to have such wonderful friends and juniors...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We would've been there to celebrate with you, but our show ended up conflicting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fortunately, we were able to help with the trials thanks to Kamishiro being so accommodating.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Coming up with all those improv topics was actually kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see the video Emu and the others took for us! Get ready to hear all about how we think you did after we get a chance to watch it, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tsukasa.
I hope this surprise allowed me to give back even a little bit considering everything you've done for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope so too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! You saw how much he enjoyed the party that came after our surprise, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, that was so worth the effort.
Well, to be fair, all I did was some video editing♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he ended up crying because he was so happy. I guess it was sort of worth helping with those trials.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, happy wonderhoy birthday♪
You try saying it too, Sakurako!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: M-Me...?! I don't really mind, but if I could also drag Kusanagi down... Rather, would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you clearly just said that you want to drag me down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Why don't we all say it together?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Fine. I suppose his acting performance merits that much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Alright, here we go!
Happy wonderhoy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Sakurako
rows.Line: Happy wonderhoy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for joining me to celebrate my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your kind and thoughtful words are like the stars in our universe. Each one shines in a way that gives me strength!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's going to take me quite a while to repay this debt, but my goal will be to put on the greatest shows possible in return.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, along with the rest of us at Wonderlands×Showtime, will be counting on your support moving forward!
